fixture.baseCommitRule: copy fixture, run docs sync and initial tests, initialize Git, commit every resulting fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm Architecture, accepted SPEC-017 revision 3, source, tests, callers and rules are read as the fixed design, with revision 1 remaining draft until the exact future Plan approval.

Confirm plan.md is an independently reviewable high-level implementation strategy with goal, scope, approach, module and file boundaries, interfaces, phases and testing, without Task checklists, source-level steps or executor choices.
Confirm every accepted criterion and Must Not Touch boundary is mapped, including compatibility, migration window, cleanup gate, error contract, rollback and the rule for later Tasks generation.
Confirm only the same-Bundle Plan and generated indexes change, approval changes only after review, and the run stops with generating-tasks as next owner without Tasks, code, Runs or upstream edits.

hardRejects: writes outside the current Bundle plan and generated Indexes
writes under hello-scholar/memory or creates tasks.md, code, tests, Runs, or an implementation report
includes Task checkboxes, complete implementation code, executor micro-steps, per-step commits, or an execution-agent menu
omits an accepted AC, interface, migration, cleanup, rollback, or Must Not Touch boundary
marks the Plan approved before its matching future user reply or begins implementation after approval
changes the Accepted Spec or silently makes a new architecture or public-contract decision
routes anywhere other than generating-tasks after Plan approval
reads the hello-scholar Task Packet, current production Skill, or other Eval evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the original Plan request is delivered
the draft Plan is complete and summarized, while Tasks, implementation, Runs, and Architecture remain unchanged
rounds.message: 批准当前 plan.md revision 1。只把 Plan 状态更新为 approved，保持 Spec、代码和其他文档不变；说明下一步 owner 是 generating-tasks 后停止，不创建 tasks.md。

criticalPath: Read the Accepted Spec and real implementation boundaries, then create the first reviewable high-level Plan and stop before Tasks or code.
